subtitle: Review usage ledger, costs and cash receipts separately; missing data stays unknown
rangeInvalid: Start date cannot be after end date
trendNote: Profit includes only sites with both usage and costs for that day. Missing points stay blank; coverage identifies partial totals and ratio estimates.
statRevenueHint: Engine ledger charges, not cash receipts
statCostHint: Engine account ledger or ratio estimate
statPartial: Sites with a cost basis only
pricingHint: Some sites are unavailable or have no costs. Totals include available data only; uncosted charges are excluded from profit. Cost ratios are estimates.
revenueSource: Engine ledger values; ratio costs are estimates and have not been reconciled against cash or supplier invoices
sourceEngineHint: Recorded account cost; not proof of payment or supplier reconciliation
ratioModalDesc: Costs default to the engine account ledger. A ratio estimates cost from ledger charges and overrides engine costs; clear it to restore engine costs.
ratioClearHint: Leave blank and save to clear the override; the site returns to engine account cost.
ratioRange: Cost rate must be a percentage between 0 and 100
accountNote: The upstream-channel view is engine-limited to "last N days" (ending today) and does not follow the date range above. Admin only.
concentrationDesc: Top 3 customers' share of total revenue ({n} customers)
breakdownEmpty: No data for this dimension in the selected period
dailyNote: Usage and costs use Beijing dates. Recharge preserves engine dates (timezone unverified) and payment currencies. Incomplete totals cover available data only.
coverage: Usage {availableSites}/{expectedSites} sites · Costs known for {costedSites} · Ratio estimates for {estimatedSites}
